title: Russia Launches 128 Drones and Two Kh-35 Missiles Overnight
detail: Overnight Nov 4-5 Russia launched two Kh-35 missiles from the Black Sea and 128 drones, including 65 jet-powered Shaheds. The Air Force says 105 drones were downed or jammed and the Kh-35 missiles were not intercepted; hits at 18 locations, debris at nine. No casualties reported in the source. Single-outlet reporting.
